name: text-audit
description: Audit a text file or directory: count the lines matching a regex and fail unless at least min_matches matched (builtin-only, zero external dependencies)

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: Regular expression whose matching lines are counted

inputs.name: min_matches
inputs.description: Minimum number of matching lines required to pass

outputs.name: passed
outputs.description: True when at least min_matches lines matched

params.message: expected at least ${inputs.min_matches} matching line(s) of ${inputs.pattern}, found ${nodes.scan.outputs.count}
